purpose: Cirrus table schemas used by the Withdrawal Auditing Service POC.
notes: These schemas document the table shapes the WAS is allowed to query.
Do not add selected columns to withdrawalAudit.service.ts unless they are present in these files or verified from Cirrus.
The generic /event table does not expose transaction_index or event_index in this codebase; use block_number, transaction_hash, transaction_sender, and block_timestamp only.
